name: codex-deepseek-bridge
description: Let an OpenAI parent delegate verified parallel work to DeepSeek or other configured provider profiles.

interface.shortDescription: Lead with OpenAI; run verified DeepSeek workers in parallel.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin powered by a local MCP bridge and routing Skill. It lets an OpenAI parent visibly delegate bounded parallel work to DeepSeek or other configured provider profiles, then verifies the runtime provider, model, reasoning effort, concurrency, and results.
defaultPrompt: Delegate two independent coding tasks to DeepSeek in parallel.
Use DeepSeek workers and show the runtime model evidence.
Run parallel workers with my configured provider profile.
